labels.shortDescription: Hours status changes only through approval
labels.value: The status of volunteer hours changes only when a coordinator approves, rejects or reopens them. New hours start as Submitted.
You need the Manage Volunteers permission to approve, reject or reopen volunteer hours. Ask your BarnCRM administrator.
Say why these hours are rejected, so the person who entered them knows what to fix.
Approved hours count in totals, so they cannot be deleted. Reopen them first (move them back to Submitted, which needs the Manage Volunteers permission), then delete them.

labels.shortDescription: A job with shifts or hours is kept
labels.value: This job has shifts or volunteer hours, so it cannot be deleted: its hours would lose their job. Clear Active instead to stop offering it.

labels.shortDescription: Second sign-up refused; {0} is the shift name
labels.value: This person is already signed up for {0}. Change the sign-up that is there instead of adding another.
